subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2021 · Fmge Mini Test 17

questions.stem: All of the following are included among the major criteria of the modified Duke's criteria for the diagnosis of infective endocarditis, except:
questions.stemHtml: All of the following are included among the major criteria of the modified Duke's criteria for the diagnosis of infective endocarditis, except:

options.label: B
options.text: Echocardiography showing endocardial involvement with definite vegetations

options.label: C
options.text: Coxiella burnetii anti-phase I IgG antibody titer greater than 1:800

options.label: D
options.text: At least two consecutive positive blood cultures for Coxiella burnetii
